proposedPublishedLabManifest.title: Dynamic field arrays
proposedPublishedLabManifest.expected: Type unique values in three rows; remove the middle row. The remaining values must match their original logical items. Adding past eight rows must be disabled.
proposedPublishedLabManifest.security: Never accept arbitrary numbers of dynamic rows on the server; cap collection lengths and validate each nested item.

sourceContract.title: Dynamic field arrays
